judged_text: Webhook handler has no error handling: no try/catch anywhere in this externally-reachable handler — schema.parse(req.body) throws ZodError on malformed bodies (unhandled 500 instead of 400, and there is no HTTP method check so a GET with no body 500s), symmetricDecrypt throws on an undecryptable payload or mis-sized key (the || "" fallback only masks misconfiguration), and JSON.parse throws if the decrypted plaintext isn't JSON; unlike other routes, it doesn't use defaultHandler/defaultResponder so the caller can't distinguish its own bad payload from server failure, and nothing is logged for diagnosis (app-credential.ts:31, 57-59)
